name: FREQUENCR
desc: real-time frequency-modulation camera. neon oscilloscope lines from camera or photos.
intro: a camera that redraws whatever it sees as frequency-modulated lines: neon oscilloscope waves that bend around hands, faces and bodies. it runs live on the camera feed or on photos from your library, with a deep set of controls to push the lines from clean signal to organic, textured noise.
features: live camera, rendered in real time with webgl shaders
frequency-modulation line rendering, neon on black
lots of controls to shape the waves, from clean to organic and textured
mobile-first camera interface: rounded viewfinder, vertical sliders, live log

name: GLYPH
desc: ascii shader tool. webgl pipeline, 50+ character sets, edge detection, webcam, png / webm export.
intro: turns images, video and your webcam into ascii art through a webgl shader pipeline. pick a character set, tune the edges and contrast, and export stills, loops, vectors or plain text.
features: export to png, webm, svg and plain ascii text

name: DTHRD
desc: dithering app. 12 algorithms, 10 character sets, 11 palettes, grid mosaic.
intro: a native ios dithering app from the glyph family. take any photo and rebuild it with classic error-diffusion and ordered dithering, character sets or colour palettes, then lay results out in a grid mosaic.

name: IICSA
desc: image effects studio. ascii, dither, halftone, vhs, pixel sort and more.
intro: a browser-based image effects studio, built mobile-first. fifteen effects in one place, from ascii and dithering to halftone, vhs and pixel sorting, tuned to feel like a native app on a phone.
features: 15 effects including ascii, dithering, halftone, vhs and pixel sort

name: SCANLINE
desc: vertical-line dithering from photos, video or live camera.
intro: rebuilds images out of vertical lines: tone becomes line weight and spacing, like an engraved print or a signal on a screen. works on imported photos and video, or live from the camera.
features: runs in the browser as a single file

name: TONE
desc: halftone overprint in 1–3 inks. riso / zine texture, am or grain screens.
intro: turns photos into halftone overprints: overlapping dots and ink in one to three colours, like a two-colour poster or a riso-printed zine. it can pick the inks that suit the photo for you, or you set every screen by hand.
features: automatic ink selection matched to the photo, or manual
dot fineness, screen angle and per-colour intensity
two screening methods: am dots and grain
three paper whites: warm, natural, white
margin, aspect ratio and corner radius
step-by-step pipeline: orig, lin, tone, gamut, separation … composite
png export for sharing and print
v3ktrz ink unlock: 7 extra inks, custom preset storage, high-res export

name: UPRES
desc: creative tiled upscaler. restores old photos with seedvr2 + flux.
intro: a creative upscaler for mobile, in the spirit of magnific. images are split into tiles, each tile is upscaled by a diffusion model, then everything is stitched back together. built to bring very old photos back toward realism.

name: STRIDE
desc: running app. gps tracking, training plans, territory claiming.
intro: a running app that turns your runs into territory. track every run with gps, follow a training plan, and claim the streets you cover on the map.

name: MONO
desc: native photo editor. raw development meets photoshop-style editing, on metal.
intro: a native macos photo editor that puts lightroom-style raw development and photoshop-style editing in one app. written in swift, rendered on metal.

name: UNBOUND CAMERA
desc: film camera. 20 metal-shader film simulations, full manual controls.
intro: the unbound camera app. twenty film simulations rendered with metal shaders, applied live, with full manual control over the shot.

name: UNBOUND
desc: brand app. shop, community feed, quests, leaderboard, avatar studio.
intro: the app for unbound, a streetwear and car culture community. shop, post, level up and build your avatar, all in one installable web app.

name: MINIMAL UI
desc: clean minimal interface overhaul for project zomboid, build 42.
intro: a project zomboid mod that rebuilds the whole interface in a clean, modern, minimal style. made for build 42.
features: options for background colour, transparency, accent colour and text size
